item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the audited income statement and the most recent fiscal year's total revenue. I’ll search the `texts` entries directly and verify the number from the statement table.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Total\\s+revenues|Revenue|income statement|Statement of Operations|Consolidated Statements of Operations|Audited' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2022_10K_reconstructed.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Total\\s+revenues|Revenue|income statement|Statement of Operations|Consolidated Statements of Operations|Audited' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2022_10K_reconstructed.json"

/bin/bash -lc "jq '.texts[] | select(.text | test(\"Total revenues|Consolidated Statements of Operations|Statement of Operations|Sales of services\"; \"i\")) | {page_no, text}' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2022_10K_reconstructed.json"

/bin/bash -lc "jq '.texts[] | select(.text | test(\"Total revenues|Consolidated Statements of Operations|Statement of Operations|Sales of services\"; \"i\")) | {page_no, text}' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2022_10K_reconstructed.json"
